extensionDescription.message: AI-powered SEO checker. Audit pages, find SEO issues, and generate optimized title and meta description suggestions.

scanConsentBody.message: SEO Copilot will read this tab's URL, metadata, headings, images, structured data, and visible text to produce your SEO report.

scanPrivacyNote.message: Basic scanning runs locally. AI Fix sends necessary page context only when you request it.

scanUnavailable.message: This page cannot be scanned. Open a regular HTTP or HTTPS page and try again.

impactTitle.message: Titles help search engines and visitors understand the page topic.

impactMeta.message: A useful description can improve how the result is understood and clicked.

impactHeading.message: A logical heading outline improves readability and topic clarity.

impactImages.message: Optimized images improve accessibility, discovery, and page performance.

impactUrl.message: Readable, concise URLs are easier for users and crawlers to understand.

impactTechnical.message: Technical signals help crawlers interpret and index the preferred page.

impactContent.message: Substantial visible content gives search engines enough context to evaluate the page.

fixTitleMissing.message: Add a unique, descriptive title between 30 and 60 characters.

issueTitleShort.message: The title is shorter than recommended.

issueTitleLong.message: The title is longer than recommended.

fixTitleLength.message: Aim for a clear title between 30 and 60 characters.

issueTitleMultiple.message: The document contains multiple title elements in the head.

fixTitleMultiple.message: Keep a single title element directly in the document head.

fixMetaMissing.message: Add a useful meta description between 120 and 160 characters.

issueMetaLength.message: The meta description length is outside the recommended range.

fixMetaLength.message: Rewrite the description to be concise and no longer than 160 characters.

issueH1Missing.message: The page has no H1 heading.

fixH1Missing.message: Add one clear H1 that describes the page topic.

issueH1Multiple.message: The page has multiple H1 headings.

fixH1Multiple.message: Keep one primary H1 and use H2 headings for sections.

issueHeadingStructure.message: The heading outline skips a level.

fixHeadingStructure.message: Nest headings in order without jumping from H1 to H3.

issueImageAlt.message: Some informative images are missing an alt attribute.

fixImageAlt.message: Add concise, meaningful alt text to informative images.

issueImageAltRatio.message: Alt coverage for informative images is below 50%.

fixImageAltRatio.message: Review alt coverage for informative images; decorative images do not need descriptive alt text.

issueImageLarge.message: An image may be a performance optimization opportunity.

fixImageLarge.message: Review the transferred bytes first; if the source is much larger than its rendered size, consider a smaller responsive variant or modern format.

issueUrlInvalid.message: The page URL is invalid or uses an unsupported protocol.

fixUrlInvalid.message: Use a valid HTTP or HTTPS page URL.

issueUrlLong.message: The page URL is longer than 100 characters.

fixUrlLong.message: Shorten the path while retaining descriptive words.

issueUrlStructure.message: The URL contains a complex query or unreadable identifier.

fixUrlStructure.message: Use a stable, readable slug and remove unnecessary parameters.

issueCanonicalMissing.message: The page has no canonical link.

fixCanonicalMissing.message: Add a canonical link that points to the preferred URL.

issueSchemaMissing.message: No valid JSON-LD structured data was detected.

fixSchemaMissing.message: Add relevant Product, Article, FAQ, or Review JSON-LD where appropriate.

issueSchemaInvalid.message: One or more JSON-LD blocks contain invalid JSON.

fixSchemaInvalid.message: Validate the JSON-LD syntax and correct malformed blocks.

issueContentLowWords.message: The page contains fewer than 300 words.

fixContentLowWords.message: Add useful, original content that fully answers the visitor's intent.

fixContentLowRatio.message: Reduce unnecessary markup and make the main content clear and accessible.

issueRobotsMissing.message: No robots meta tag was detected.

fixRobotsMissing.message: Add a robots directive when the page needs explicit crawl guidance.
